name: edit_abstract_v2
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,subprocess,sys
p=pathlib.Path('src/BunDomAbstract.lean'); s=p.read_text().replace('import Mathlib.Tactic
','import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Omega
')
s=s.replace('    dsimp only
','').replace('  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hn','  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hn
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hn').replace('∀ t s ∈ S,','∀ t, ∀ s ∈ S,')
s=s.replace('by cases s; simp_all [flip]','by
        apply Prod.ext <;> exact ha')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',str(p)],input=s,text=True,check=True)
